faqs.question: How can I get into Avanthi Institute Of Engineering And Technology for UG/PG courses? Am I eligible for admission?
faqs.answer:
Avanthi Institute Of Engineering And Technology has below criteria for taking admissions to it's various courses:
Courses Eligibility
B.E. / B.Tech Candidates who have passed Diploma in Engineering or any other examination recognised as equivalent there to, from a recognised Institute/ University, Andhra Pradesh/ Telangana are also eligible. Candidates who have appeared in Diploma in Engineering and who are awaiting their results can also apply on provisional basis. Candidates should belong to the state of Andhra Pradesh/ Telangana. Candidate should have completed 16 years of age as of 31st December of the year of admission (2023). There is no upper age limit.
After 10th Diploma Candidates should have passed S.S.C. Examination (Class 10th) conducted by State Board of Secondary Education, Andhra Pradesh/ Telangana or any other examination recognised as equivalent thereto by the Board of Secondary Education, A.P/TS. such as CBSE, ICSE, NIOS, A.P. Open School Society (APOSS), X class examination conducted by various State Boards of Secondary Education in India with Mathematics as one of the subjects. Candidates belonging to NIOS/APOSS/Other Examinations recognised as equivalent to SSC by A.P. Govt. should have passed all the subjects including Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, with minimum of 35% marks in each subject. Candidates who appeared or are appearing for SSC or equivalent examination being held in April/ May-2023, and whose results are yet to be declared can also apply. There is no age restriction.
M.E./M.Tech Candidate must have passsed B.E./B.Tech. in relevant stream and obtained at least 50% marks (45% in case of reserved category candidates) from an AICTE/UGC approved institution recognised by the Government of Andhra Pradesh as equivalent thereto. Final year appearing students may also apply on provisional basis.
MBA/PGDM Candidate must have completed Bachelor degree of 3/4 years duration with above mentioned marks from any recognised University/Institute. 45% marks for BC categories. Candidate who are appearing for the final year degree examination are also be eligible. Degree obtained by Distance Mode Program should have recognition by Joint Committee of UGC, AICTE and DEC/DEB. Candidate who passed all the subjects of the three years of any Degree course in one sitting is not eligible for admission.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: In the next couple of years, one of the best colleges will be for campus placements.

review_content.Placements: In my college, above 80 percent of placements are done in the last academic year. Especially in my electronics communication department, 90 percent of all cleared students are placed. The highest package is 12 LPA, the lowest is 2.5 LPA, and the average is 4 LPA to 4.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are IBM, Infosys, Tata, etc. Internships are also good. 75% percent of students got internships. The top roles in our course are embedded systems, VLSI design, and analog communication.
review_content.Infrastructure: In recent times, the facilities for students have been greatly increased, providing Wi-Fi labs, equipment in labs, and advanced books in labs. I am a 2nd-year student, especially a hostel student. Morning food is very nice, afternoon food is not upto mark, and evening food is also good. The medical facilities are also available in the hostel. Recently, the college also conducted a cricket tournament.

reviews_list.review_title: Avanthi College is the best college.

reviews_list.review_title: It has good infrastructure and facilities.

reviews_list.review_title: I will give a 3 out of 5 review to our college.

reviews_list.review_title: The ultimate all-rounder college.

faqs.question: How can I get into Sri Krishna Institute of Technology for UG/PG courses? Am I eligible for admission?
faqs.answer:
Sri Krishna Institute of Technology has below criteria for taking admissions to it's various courses:
Courses Eligibility
B.E. / B.Tech Candidate must have passed VIII, IX, X, XI & XII Std. from schools situated in Tamil Nadu. Tamil Nadu native candidate who have passed any of the VIII, IX, X, XI & XII Std. or their equivalent exam from schools situated outside Tamil Nadu can also apply. They should produce Original Nativity Certificate. Children of Central Government Employees, irrespective of their nativity, provided their parents or guardians (only if both parents are not alive) have been serving in Tamil Nadu continuously for the past five years can be eligible to apply. Sons & daughters of All India service Tamil Nadu cadre officers are eligible to apply. A Self declaration from the parent in this regard is to be produced. Children of employees in the Public Sector or Government recognised institutions had been working in their organisations for the past five years are also eligible, irrespective of their domicile. Other State candidates who have studied VIII, IX, X, XI and XII Std. in Tamil Nadu are eligible to apply.

The quality of the food is a little bit low but fine when compared to other colleges. It provides good facilities for medical purposes and extracurricular activities like games. The managem...

reviews.review_heading: Worth joining the campus. Good in all aspects.
reviews.review_text: In Srikakulam campus, up to now (2025), they have facilities up to B.Tech 2nd year. They are still under construction for 3rd and 4th-year students. Later, students will study in the Nuzvidu campus. But this construction will be done within a year. Coming to food, we have a mess and a canteen. Mess food is okay. The canteen is provided with minimal charges. Medical facilities, sports, and games are provided with good quality. A wide range of labs, classrooms, and a library are provided. A laptop...

reviews.review_heading: Our college provided a stress-free environment.
reviews.review_text: Our college provided a free Wi-Fi connection with a 2 GB per day limit. There were newly established labs on our campus. Hostel rooms were in good and hygienic condition. They provided quality food. There was a small hospital available in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely good because of faculty and good placements in 2024.
reviews.review_text: My college is very beautiful with greenery. Here, the labs are newly equipped for engineering. Engineering students have access to unlimited Wi-Fi. Classrooms are large and silent. The library is also good, with many books and A.C. Sports and games are available, with a very big ground. Medical facilities are good. The quality of food in the mess and canteen is average.

reviews.review_heading: Review of RGUKT Srikakulam.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are good, but not the food. The worst food I have ever seen. The ambulance is available 24/7 and all the working days, the sports are opened, and there is permission for those who are enthusiastic about the games. Our parents also help them achieve their dreams in the sports and games .

reviews.review_heading: Best college for poor and talented people.
reviews.review_text:
Free Wi-Fi,24*7 hospital,24 hours water, good food. Electricity, heavy infrastructure.
Food is provided in main mess for students who go late.
Milk and bread provided for unhealthy students.
In addition to mess there is food court which with affordable cost.

reviews.review_heading: The overall review is okay.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good. Each classroom has Wi-Fi, but there are few classrooms for a large number of students. The infrastructure is good, but it is not enough for the strength that our college has. Recently, the food quality has changed. The hostel maintenance is okay.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very good. There is privacy for girls and boys.
reviews.review_text: There were no sufficient classrooms. Wi-Fi was available. The library was okay, but there were only limited books there. There was no Wi-Fi in the hostel. In the canteen, there were only 2-3 items available. The medical facility was okay. There were 2 PEDS there, but they could not teach you.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of friends, really good infrastructure and facilities but faculty is quite bad.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, and Wi-Fi facility is provided. Labs, classrooms, and library are good. The food in the mess is of poor quality but is okay sometimes. We have a canteen, and it is good. The medical facilities are okay, but sometimes they are not good. I wish they were improved, it would be good.

reviews.review_heading: We don’t have to pay fee to my college if we are eligible for scholarship provided by government.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for my computer course, like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and library, are not very good because my campus is small in area, so we face difficulties in managing classwork. My present campus in Srikakulam has 2 batches.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good infrastructure and good faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. We have well-facilitated classrooms with projectors and also Wi-Fi connections. In the hostel rooms, they provide Wi-Fi. We have a very big library on our campus, and labs are also very well constructed. Overall, the environment is also nice.

reviews.review_heading: My experience to my college .
reviews.review_text:
Coming to infrastructure there is good infrastructure in our college and it is good design also. It's is long time durability and good quality 
And coming to the classes there a advanced level of infrastructure is there. And also labs in our college are very beautiful constructed and also some construction works also going on. There is a library also there are 3500+ books are there.

reviews.review_heading: The perfect place to learn engeenering for the latest technologies .
reviews.review_text: Really loved the facilities and infrastructure available for us. The interesting part is college provides Wi-Fi for academic purpose and the labs are very interesting and the classrooms are well technical and the library is very good for all students all the books are available. The quality of food is excellent and the canteen is excellent and the medical facilities are really amazing and every month they conduct sports meets for all.

reviews.review_heading: Very disciplined and strict.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms have enough space for everyone, and there is a good library. Facilities are poor in hostels, and the food quality is not very good. There are separate grounds for boys and girls. Infrastructure needs improvement, and construction is underway to accommodate more students.

reviews.review_heading: Good journey with this college.
reviews.review_text:
1) Our college's facilities were excellent, including Wi-Fi, labs, and libraries.They were all good, and the infrastructure of our college was awesome. It really looks very good.
2) The quality of facilities was average in our hostel, but the food quality was very hygienic on both the canteen and mess floor, the medical facilities were not good, and sports and games were limited in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Nice and amazing experience.
reviews.review_text: Facilities were good in our department like Wi-Fi was available in all departments and computer labs were full with all the equipments and classrooms were neat and clean. Infrastructure of the college was amazing even many singers come for shooting in our college. The quality of food was very good in both mess and canteen, medical facilities were not that much good, sports and games were limited played in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty members of the college.
reviews.review_text:
1) The facilities were good enough. Even there were all kinds of facilities available like Wi-Fi, labs were fully equipped, and there were two libraries in our college. And the infrastructure was good of our college. 
2) The quality of facilities is average in hostel, but the food quality was good in both canteen and mess, limited sports and games were played on campus, medical facilities were not good in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Awesome experience with college and college Aluminies.
reviews.review_text: There are all kind of facilities available in campus like Wi-Fi, labs are fully equipped, classrooms are neat and clean, Library is also equipped with all kinds of books and journals. Infrastructure of college in general is awesome. The quality of each and every facility provided in our college is good be it games or food. The only facility lacking behind is medical facility which is poor.

reviews.review_heading: Really amazing experience.
reviews.review_text:
1) The facilities were really good. There were many kinds of facilities like Wi-Fi, sports facilities and the infrastructure of the college includes almost everything. 
2) The quality of facilities was average. There were limited amenities in the hostel. The quality of food is good. Every day there were different kinds of food served in both canteen and mess, medical facilities were not very good and there were limited sports and games played on campus.

reviews.review_heading: This college is not good for technical students.
reviews.review_text: Our college had limited facilities. Wi-Fi was not available throughout the campus. Our classrooms were not clean, and our labs were not fully equipped. The quality of food was good in the mess and canteen. Different meals were served in the mess daily. The quality of food was very good in the canteen. Sports and games were not given preference. Limited sports were played.

reviews.review_heading: Not a satisfactory college for new comers.
reviews.review_text:
1) There are limited facilities like Wi-Fi, labs are not fully equipped with instruments and some computers were not working in labs and there are two libraries 1 of them was temporarily closed. 
2) There are all facilities in the hostel you get, the quality of food is good in both mess and college canteen, medical facilities were not good in our college and there are limited games played on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Our college had good placements in 2021 and 2022.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good facilities and infrastructure. The hostel has a Wi-Fi facility. Labs are good in condition and have air conditioners. Some computers are not working well in computer labs. Classrooms are very good in condition. Green boards are installed in classrooms.

reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied with its placements.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like Wi-Fi and broadband connections are available. It has a computer laboratory. There are two libraries in our college but one is temporarily closed. There are two hostels, one for boys and another one for girls. The food served in the canteen is better. Mess is also available. Medical facilities are not good in our college. There are limited sports and games on our campus.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best colleges in the Punjab state.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available. Labs are well defined, and the classrooms are surely designed well. One of the best things of our college is its library. There are thousands of books available in our library which are useful to the students of every course and also the faculty.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing experience with college.
reviews.review_text:
1) There are all kinds of facilities available in our college like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, libraries etc. And the infrastructure is well and good. 
2) The quality of facilities is average in our college. The food quality is average in mess and canteen, medical facilities is also provided, There are various competitions of sports and games held at our college.

reviews.review_heading: Average placements, good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available like Wi-Fi, labs, library, workshops, etc. Hostel facility is also average, Mess is average, canteen facility is there, medical facilities are there and also sports activities and NCC etc. That is also there. Again I will say average.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Shaheed Udham Singh College of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities are good. Hostel mess is also good as compared to other colleges. Hostels provide you with almirah, a bed, a table, a cooler, and a fan. You can choose between 2 sharing and three sharing bedrooms. They provide various curricular activities and various labs to enhance your skills.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is medium level. The placements opportunities are good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Various facilities are available like Wi-Fi, laboratories, classrooms, and libraries. The hostel facilities are good, the food is of medium quality. There are medical rooms in our college. Various sports tournaments are organised in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has a good placement record and it also provides good facilities.
reviews.review_text: We have facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, a library, etc. The quality of food served is great. Management is very supportive. There is a mess and a canteen facility also. Medical facilities are provided. We also have sports and games. Various competitions are held on campus. It is a good college.

reviews.review_text: Our campus features modern computer labs, smart classrooms, a well-stocked library, and dedicated courts for volleyball, football, basketball, and badminton. It offers a balanced environment for both academic learning and overall student development.

reviews.review_heading: Lachoo Memorial College - Jodhpur's best BCA college.
reviews.review_text: I'm studying in BCA department. Infrastructure is not good. But in recent times, especially after 2022, the management has improved the infrastructure by building new labs and classes. An entire building dedicated to B.Tech was made. Overall, students enjoy a good academic life.

reviews.review_heading: There were good placements in 2023.
reviews.review_text: Labs are good, and the library is great for self-paced study. The classrooms are a bit good, and Wi-Fi is available in labs and the library. BCA offers us the opportunity to study and learn coding, programming languages, and computers. There is no hostel on campus, but there are hostels and PGs available nearby.

reviews.review_heading: Supportive faculty and a relevant curriculum with scope for improving practical training.

The canteen food is tasty and affordable, offering a variety of snacks and meals. Medical facilities are reliable, with a health center. Sports and games facilities are good. It includes playgrounds, courts, indoor games, and a gym to support physical fitness and recreation for students.

reviews.review_heading: If you want zero tension about your academics then go for it.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is average. I know about computer labs only because I have completed a BCA from this college. All the systems in the lab are in good condition but their software is too old like they have Windows 7, etc. The library is there. Quite a good library. Almost all the books are available but a few books around 2-3 books only are allowed for free.

reviews.review_heading: The environment of college.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is average. College environment is not good. It is very strict and security management is not good. College does not provide Wi-Fi facility. College only provides classrooms, lab, and library. College does not provide sports and games facilities.

reviews.review_heading: In the college, there are no placements. The faculty is good.
reviews.review_text: Labs are good. Classrooms are also good. The library is also good for study. In the library, there is a full quietness. The food of the canteen is also good. In the college, there is a sports faculty to do regular sports activities. There is no Wi-Fi here.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for those who want to make their future bright.
reviews.review_text: There are labs, classrooms, a library, and an auditorium. No hostel is available. Good food is available in the canteen, along with first aid kits for players. All outdoor and indoor games are available. The canteen provides only vegetarian food, fast food, and healthy food, as well as shakes.

reviews.review_heading: It is an average college.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is good, with good quality and well-maintained labs. But classrooms are not well-maintained as there is no regular dusting and cleaning. Students will get access to a large central library where we will find more than 10,000 books, both curricular as well as co-curricular.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty, staff, and sports.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are spacious, and we don't face any issues with the seating system. Labs are well-cleaned and have good software in the lab PCs. The Wi-Fi connection is good and fast. The library is also good; we get every book related to our course, and they don't charge us for any books. The college has most sports facilities like cricket, football, basketball, tennis, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Kinda satisfied with the PHARMA college of Rajasthan.
reviews.review_text: In our course, we are provided with labs, computer labs, and access to sports courts, including basketball and badminton courts. However, the quality of our classrooms is very poor; we don’t have enough fans in our classrooms and labs relative to their size.

reviews.review_heading: The faculty is really nice. The feels is high compared with campus and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: If you talk about infrastructure, you will not get too good and not too bad either. The campus infrastructure is some years old, established in 1964, so there are no hostel facilities available and no Wi-Fi. You will get a sports field, some sports facilities, a decent library, and labs.

reviews.review_heading: If you just want to take admission for a degree, this is for you.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided by the college are good except for some labs. The college still uses the old systems, and the computers and software in them are the oldest versions, but they have changed some labs with the latest software and hardware. There will be no Wi-Fi, the classrooms are old with old-age chairs, and there is a library in the college that provides books for 15 days for free.

reviews.review_heading: I recommend students to take admission to this college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided in our college are good except for some labs. Our college uses old computers and the oldest software but they have changed some labs with the latest software and hardware. Wi-Fi is not provided. Classrooms are old with old chairs. It has a library that issues free books for 15 days.

individual_reviews.title: It's a worthless college, and placements are not worth the money. But, it's good in infrastructure.

content.Placements: About 20% of the students from our course got placed. The highest salary package offered was 5.6 LPA, while the lowest salary package offered was 2.3 LPA. GGK Construction and Lodha Construction are the top recruiters for our course. Maybe 20% to 30% of my friends got internships in companies like Lodha Construction, GK Construction as well as in Roa Group of Construction. The top role offered is an assistant manager in Lodha Construction.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities were not bad in our college, and I didn't like them. The infrastructure is average, but courses are fine but no that good to compare. The hostel was very bad with less hygiene facilities as well as very bad food. The food served in the canteen is fine, but some students can't afford because of high rates. Our college doesn't provide sports.

individual_reviews.title: The college has good infrastructure, faculty members and modern technology.

content.Placements: Around 70% of students get placed on campus. The rest of the students get placed after completing their course. The highest package offered to freshers is about 10,000 per month, and the lowest package is about 7,000 per month. Some of the midrange companies conduct campus interviews in our college. Some students, about 50%, got internships in the 3rd year itself. Only associate level roles are offered by companies.

It has the latest labs and good faculty members with higher qualifications such as M.E etc. The classrooms are very good and attractive with green boards, new benches, and Wi-Fi facility. Compared to other colleges, all the facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: I miss my college and friends.
reviews.review_text:

reviews.review_heading: My College and What's good about it.
reviews.review_text: College had great facilities. It had high-speed Wi-Fi available in all classrooms and labs. The food at mess was yummy and tasty. There was medical facilities available 24 hours for people living in hostel. The college always encouraged to take part in sport activities like basketball etc.

reviews.review_heading: It was the worst decision of my life.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility was not that good, and equipment in the lab were orthodox. Food quality was satisfactory in the canteen. The college does not provide educational tours, and the education system was orthodox. Extracurricular activities were negligible. Only one fest was organised. Infrastructure was good, though.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure and facilities were good in our college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of our college were huge, and the library is equipped with full of books.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Haryana College of Technology and Management (HCTM).
reviews.review_text: The campus environment is very good for students. For a peaceful study, there is a library on the campus. The Wi-Fi facility is available for students to study. The staff are good. Classrooms are well-equipped. There is also a canteen on the campus, and it is quite a good place that provides food. Overall, it is the best.

reviews.review_heading: Nothing good about college but meet a lot of good friends which means a lot to me.
reviews.review_text: Our college's infrastructure was quite good. Some Students were so talented, now they reached new heights in other activities like sports and music. I was not a hosteler but students who were hostelers always complaining about food provided by the college in mess. Some of students only stay in hostel but used to eat food from outside places.

reviews.review_heading: This is best college for engineering and management.
reviews.review_text: It's infrastructure is very good. It is built in 26 acres. And good library is also there for the students in which all types of books are available. It has also parks or grounds to play. Iy is a famous college, it is in 26 acres. It has many blocks. Different blocks for different branches. Very branch has practical purpose things. It's nice to study in this college. It provide nice environment for study. Library is available for study.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, better teaching staff, good scholarships programs.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was no doubt good. There were 7 different blocks, with 3 floors in each block, having across 100 rooms and more than 40 labs. The food was good in the canteen. I have not stayed in the hostel, so I am not pretty much sure about that. We have not faced any infrastructure issue there.

reviews.review_heading: A college with declining placements and events.
reviews.review_text: The college is situated on Hisar- Chandigarh Highway. The campus is lush green and very good to look. It has a lush green garden for cricket. Different blocks are there for different branches with different classes. The campus is completely Wi-Fi enabled, and you don't face any problem with electricity in this college.

reviews.review_heading: The best HCTM campus among Haryana engineering campuses.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very well and famous among Haryana for its facilities and environment. It has a separate library block, parks and playgrounds. Apart, it's a bit difficult for you to use that, but it is available if you can avail them by hook or crook.

reviews.review_heading: A great period of life.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities offered by the college were adequate. The building was good and maintained. The classrooms were spacious, and a projector was there. The hostel was average, and the food at the mess was also average, I would say, not too good and not too bad type. We used to enjoy every meal as it was good and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied in each and every respect.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is okay. There are Wi-Fi with limited access and labs with the faulty computers. The food is the worst for hostlers. The classrooms are okay. Everyone will face the issue in this. Non-trustworthy college, avoid it.

reviews.review_heading: Extremely bad college with great faculty members without any doubt.
reviews.review_text: It had a good luscious green environment but the other infrastructure like benches, chairs and seminar hall, were all pathetic. The gym in the girl's hostel was just a waste. All the machines that were scrap were installed there. The food the cooks made sometimes had the smell of kerosene, and they claimed that it felt accidental. There are so much of disappointments from the college.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with the faculty and the placements are poor.
reviews.review_text: The buildings are good, and the infrastructure is above average according to the area. The Wi-Fi services are good. The classrooms and labs well build. The hostel and playgrounds are also good. The medical facilities are not good. There are no precautions for emergency situations or any mishaps.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty were good in the civil department. Infrastructure is brilliant
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is brilliant. There is a three-floor building. Labs are good medical facilities is good also they arrange a blood donation camp, etc. A lot of extracurricular activities are there in the college and a lot of games are also there with no issues at all in the infrastructure.
